name: Caterpillar - Tejon Ranch (Lebec) CA Parts Distribution Center
type: Parts distribution center (~400k sq ft, opened ~2012)

fieldNotes.location: LOW CONFIDENCE on exact building. Roster had no street address (geocode APPROXIMATE) and the roster point was in hills near I-5, ~16 km from the actual site. Confirmed via Tejon Ranch Co. / Clayco that the facility IS at the Tejon Ranch Commerce Center (TRCC), at the I-5/Hwy 99 junction near Lebec/Grapevine: a 409,000 sq ft one-level tilt-up parts distribution center plus a 200,000 sq ft outdoor oversized-parts storage area, on a 46-acre site, dedicated Jan 2013.
fieldNotes.building: Best-match building locked at ~35.0012,-118.9405: a large (~400k+ sq ft) one-level distribution building with two-phase construction (original white-roof section + grey-roof expansion - consistent with the documented 'room next door for an additional 350k sq ft'), a large outdoor yard on the E side (consistent with the 200k sq ft oversized-parts outdoor storage), dock doors on the S face, and employee car parking on the W. Could NOT positively confirm via signage that this specific TRCC building is Caterpillar versus an adjacent tenant - flagged.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Modern distribution warehouse - the truck dock yard on the S/E side is typically gated/fenced. truckGate set true, guardShack false / remoteGs true on a remote-checkin assumption - all flagged given the building could not be positively confirmed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run along the S building face; estimated ~24, 25-50 band - flagged (overhead estimate, limited imagery resolution).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large outdoor yard E of the building used for oversized-parts storage and trailer staging; dropArea 25-50, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; TRCC warehouses are truck-served (the rail line follows the I-5 corridor but does not enter the site).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - TRCC sits at the foot of the Grapevine surrounded by farmland and open hills, not within a metro's dense fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 46 acres per the Tejon Ranch Co. land-acquisition press release.
